people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.
translations.bsb: So he left them in the care of the king of Moab, and they stayed with him the whole time David was in the stronghold.
translations.kjv: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.
translations.asv: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the stronghold.
